# 📖 SWEET & REIMAGINED (V 0.1.0 PRE-ALPHA)

_This modpack is just my way of showing how I’d make Minecraft look. I’ll update it every once in a while, but since I’m in school right now, there might be times when I can’t communicate as much._

## ✨ Features

**BETTER VISUALS** - _Complementary Shaders - Reimagined_
![Overworld (Shaders Enabled)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5acccee7aab817b10748b1b4715952307b5a99e.png)
![Nether (Shaders Enabled)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6df0578ec18f1a524fdf77de1ec6cce069b9b2b7.png)
![The End (Shaders Enabled)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1fc49229f4cb94db27c7ab2c00c4e8f700391083.png)
**PERFORMANCE MATTERS**

_(Old Low End Laptop)_
- 74 - 113 FPS (No Shaders)
- 33 - 45 FPS _(Shader)_

_(High End PC)_
- 665 FPS (No Shaders)
- 273 FPS _(Shader)_

**MOB AI TWEAKS**

## 🛠️ Compatibility

**Minecraft Version(s):** 1.21.11

**Mod Loader:** Fabric

### 📦 Installation

Download and install the correct mod loader (Fabric).

Place the .jar file into your mods folder.

**Launch Minecraft and enjoy!**

### 📌 Notes

Credits: https://vanillatweaks.net/****

Configurable via mod menu.

**Suggestions and bug reports are welcome!**
